metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented a complete Node.js CLI tool at [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js) with a runnable wrapper [output/iges](/workspace/output/iges).

It supports all required subcommands:

- `parse`
- `write`
- `query`
- `eval`
- `roundtrip`

and implements:

- IGES fixed-format section parsing/writing (80-column records)
- Global section delimiter detection + Hollerith parsing
- Canonical JSON I/O envelope (`start_lines`, `global`, `entities`)
- Directory/parameter section handling with DE cross-reference checks
- Entity parsing/serialization across the provided catalog
- Diagnostics envelope and exit-code behavior per contract
- Parametric evaluation for the required curve/surface families (with transforms applied after local eval)
- Deterministic writer layout and one-line Terminate section emission

I also validated it locally with smoke tests for:

- `write -> parse`
- `roundtrip` fixed-point (`roundtrip(roundtrip(x))` byte-identical on generated files)
- `eval` on a Type 110 line
- custom Global delimiters (non-default `param_delimiter`/`record_delimiter`)
